rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Prompt Rejector is a dual-layer security gateway for AI agents and applications. It protects AI-powered applications from prompt injection attacks, jailbreak attempts, and traditional web vulnerabilities (XSS, SQLi, Shell Injection) by screening untrusted input before it reaches the agent's control plane. Provides both a REST API and MCP server interface for integration with Claude, Cursor, and other MCP-compatible clients.
